facts.fact: MENRS and UNESCO held a workshop 29 July-2 August 2024 on a project, agreed December 2022 and running 35 months to 14 February 2026, to operationalise a human-resources module integrated into the central SIGE and compatible with STATEDUC.

facts.fact: The African Union Commission says a workshop in Bujumbura on 9-11 June 2026 aims to strengthen Burundi's EMIS, amid validation of the country's EMIS strategy.

UNESCO's notice says the ministry, under a December 2022 Burundi-UNESCO agreement, has built the 'GRH MENRS' human-resources module of its SIGE and installed hardware and software, with internet, solar backup, data import and a first HR statistical yearbook still to come.
